title.zh: Bitget says Bitcoin withdrawals are open after $387M hack, but ETH and USDT must wait
title.en: Bitget says Bitcoin withdrawals are open after $387M hack, but ETH and USDT must wait

current_state.zh: Bitget reopened Bitcoin-network BTC withdrawals on Sept. 28 as the first stage of its phased post-breach plan, while ETH and USDT withdrawals remain scheduled for later dates after the Sept. 24 hot-wallet compromise.
